Welsh writer Jon Ronson sits down with Joe Rogan in episode 668 of the Joe Rogan Experience. Ronson wrote The Men Who Stare at Goats and The Psychopath Test, books that mix humor with uneasy truths. His gentle style hides a sharp eye for strange people.

Ronson talks about psychopaths, public shaming, and the odd worlds his reporting takes him into. He shares how he gains the trust of extremists, gurus, and spies alike. Rogan asks about the human cost of online pile-ons, a topic Ronson later wrote a book on. The result is odd, humane, and very British in tone.
